definitions.explanation: Lacking any plan or forethought; doing things in a disorganized way.

examples.japanese: {無計画|むけいかく}な⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧。
{無計画|むけいかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{無駄遣|むだづか}い→無駄遣い：07310_mudazukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: If you shop without a plan, wasteful spending increases.

examples.japanese: {無計画|むけいかく}な⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}{破壊|はかい}→環境破壊：15957_kankyouhakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながった。
examples.english: Unplanned development led to environmental destruction.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧ (plan). Used both as a na-adjective ({無計画|むけいかく}な) and as a noun. Often carries a negative connotation, implying carelessness or irresponsibility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無計画|むけいかく}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧: unplanned actions
- {無計画|むけいかく}な⟦{支出|ししゅつ}→支出：03169_shishutsu⟧: unplanned spending
- {無計画|むけいかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧: to proceed without a plan
- {無計画|むけいかく}な⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧: unplanned urban development

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{行|い}き{当|あ}たりばったり→行き当たりばったり：27217_ikiataribattari⟧: haphazard; random — more colloquial; emphasizes leaving things to chance
- {計画性|けいかくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: lacking planning ability — focuses on a personal trait rather than a specific action
- ⟦{無秩序|むちつじょ}→無秩序：21429_muchitsujo⟧: disorderly; chaotic — stronger, implying active disorder rather than just lack of planning
